About

My strongest work lives where brand direction and social behavior meet.

I know how to steward scale—leading integrated campaigns, budgets and agency teams inside a major consumer brand. I also know how to start with an empty page: define a positioning, make the product, build the content system and find the first audience.

Having worked and studied across China, the US and France, I adapt more than language. I look for the cultural tension, platform behavior and storytelling code that make an idea feel native in each market.
